title: Strategy Management in the Public Sector
overview: This course delves into the critical role of national competitiveness and explores the strategy pyramid within the public sector. Participants will learn how to establish a national vision, cascade this vision to various entities, set Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success measurement, formulate public policies, and collaborate with partners to execute strategies through initiatives.
audience: This course is ideal for managers and professionals involved in shaping, supporting, or influencing the planning and strategy of government or semi-government entities, departments, or corporations
methodology: The course examines best practices in strategy management from various nations worldwide, including the UAE, Singapore, the UK, and the US. The balanced scorecard framework, adapted specifically for the public sector, serves as the primary model for strategy management.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the structure of the public sector and the importance of national competitiveness for prosperity and growth.
Convert stakeholder ambitions and needs into a strategic plan that aligns with an entity’s mandate.
Effectively employ public policy development processes to achieve strategic goals.
Design and manage strategic initiatives and foster cross-entity collaboration to ensure successful strategy execution.
Implement a robust performance management system to cultivate and sustain a performance-driven culture.
